name: AIProfileCard
description: AIProfileCard is a progressive-density entity summary card optimized for two placement contexts: inline in a chat thread (max-width 520px) and full-width inside a side drawer. Basic density surfaces identity only. Simple adds Decile chip, KOL role chip, and a three-stat row. Rich adds AI badge, confidence badge, sentiment badge, and a brief insight callout. Robust replaces the insight callout with a full AI Recommendation panel with primary and secondary CTAs.
intent: Entity profile · 4 densities · 3 themes · chat + drawer contexts
